description: Factorized rules plus only explicitly named realization operations.

interaction_rules.name: DO-support question operation
interaction_rules.definition: Insert finite DO, leave the lexical verb base, and invert DO with the subject.
interaction_rules.rationale: DO insertion plus inversion is a qualitatively distinct surface operation.

interaction_rules.name: DO-support negation operation
interaction_rules.definition: Insert finite DO before NOT and leave the lexical verb in base form.
interaction_rules.rationale: DO insertion for negation is distinct from merely placing NOT after an existing operator.

interaction_rules.name: perfect-progressive chain
interaction_rules.definition: Order and inflect HAVE + BEEN + present participle as one multi-auxiliary chain.
interaction_rules.rationale: The chain combines two auxiliary relations in a fixed order.

interaction_rules.name: progressive-passive chain
interaction_rules.definition: Order and inflect finite BE + BEING + lexical past participle.
interaction_rules.rationale: Two BE auxiliaries receive different morphological forms in a fixed chain.

interaction_rules.name: perfect-passive chain
interaction_rules.definition: Order and inflect HAVE + BEEN + lexical past participle.
interaction_rules.rationale: Perfect and passive auxiliaries form a distinct ordered chain.
